sourceHeadings: Common component developer and operability contract
file02DeveloperContract.role: Live bytes. File 02 requires language analyzers and tools not to reimplement cross-cutting product behavior. The host plus common component SDK/control contract provides standardized structured candidate/result/fault envelopes and host-owned human, JSON, and applicable SARIF projection; diagnostic taxonomy, redaction, bounds, structured logging/audit correlation, progress, and status; schema-checked configuration with provenance and brokered secret handles; artifact/state brokers, cancellation, deadlines, resource reporting, trust, lifecycle, and doctor integration; and consistent host verdict/finalization/D9/exit mapping. Components may emit domain candidates, events, progress, and bounded structured diagnostics. They must not render product UI directly, choose verdicts/exits, seal evidence, write unstructured host logs, or bypass host brokers. Common look-and-feel and operability across components are DR-125/DR-G20 acceptance properties; exact SDK APIs and frameworks remain implementation design. Control-plane may carry cancellation/health/resource/fault control and must not translate provider meaning. This specification does not rewrite those bytes.

file01OutputProjections.role: Live bytes. Output surfaces are host-owned projections; they do not participate in analysis, policy, evidence authority, finalization, or D9. SARIF 2.1.0 remains an optional projection and is not required of every command. File 01's V2 readiness extension still names DR-G17 historically. D-077 dropped SARIF_for_analyze; G17 is inapplicable and not required-now. This specification consumes the host-owned-projection rule and the optional-applicability rule. It does not restore G17 and does not treat file 01's historical G17 mention as putting G17 back into required-now.
